name: YIELD
summaryHtml: Ends processing for the current tick. Returns 1 (yield), suspending execution until the next frame.

name: SCRIPT_RUN
summaryHtml:
Save caller context and spawn a sub-script.
Saves the caller's context (triggers, character, object name, SSF node) into script slot fields, then invokes Command_00 to yield. Used to run a child script and wait for it.

name: JUMP
summaryHtml:
Unconditional / conditional branch.
Payload word 0 bits [23:0] = signed 24-bit word offset; bits [31:24] = optional condition byte.
If condition byte is non-zero, an extra 8-byte condition descriptor follows and is tested via CheckCondition; jump taken only on match. Offset is relative to the end of the payload. Sign-extended from bit 23.

name: TRIGGER
summaryHtml:
Register, test, or clear a various-trigger on the current script slot.
Payload[0] byte 0 = trigger type (1 / 6 / 7 / 0xA / 0xB / 0xC …).
arg2 bits [7:6] selects mode:
  • 0/1 — Register trigger (finds free slot in 8-entry trigger array)
  • 2 — Check trigger (CVariousTrigger::Checking), result stored in bit 2 of slot byte 1
  • 3 — Clear all triggers matching the given type
Type 0x0A dispatches further on arg2 bits [1:0] to attach an SSF node name (from slot, payload, or "Root").

name: SCRIPT_LAUNCH
summaryHtml:
Launch a new parallel script.
Payload[0] low 16 bits = script ID; bits [23:16] = option flags.
Character ID resolved via abstraction. Optional condition check. Allocates a new script slot via SetScriptNumber, optionally sets default character / object name, copies memory/trigger data, and runs the first step immediately.
If arg2 bit 7 set, registers a "waiting" link-back.

name: YIELD_COND
summaryHtml: Conditional yield. Evaluates a condition via CheckCondition; if true delegates to Command_00 (yield, returns 1). If false, continues without yielding (returns 0).

name: LOAD_SCRIPT
summaryHtml:
Request loading a new event-script file.
Payload[0] low 15 bits = file ID. arg2 bit 0 sets the "immediate" flag (bit 15 of ID). ID 0 → pass −1 (release). Calls CRadiScript::LoadScriptFile.

name: GAME_MODE
summaryHtml:
Change the game mode via CRadiScene::ChangeGameMode.
arg2 bits [5:0] = mode ID. On success writes flag 0x63 with a 1-bit bitmask; on failure triggers error ("r_script_run0.cpp" line 0x1A0).

name: STOP_SCRIPT
summaryHtml:
Stop a running script.
Payload[0] bits [31:24] = optional condition byte; bits [15:0] = target script ID.
Resolves character via abstraction. Searches for the matching running slot and calls StopScript. If the current slot is the target, returns 0 (self-skip).

name: SWITCH
summaryHtml:
Switch / case dispatcher.
Reads a value from one of several sources (literal, flags, event-value, random-range) based on arg2 bits [2:0]. Searches a marker table via GetMarkerAddress for a matching case; on match sets IP to that marker (returns 2 = jump taken). Supports less-than matching as fallback.

name: WAITING_SETUP
summaryHtml:
Configure the script slot's waiting callback.
Stores the current IP into the slot's "waiting address" field, saves arg2 and p_len into the slot header. If a callback function pointer is already registered, calls it immediately.

name: NOP
summaryHtml: Does nothing. Returns 0 immediately (jr $ra; move $v0, $zero).

name: SET_FLAG
summaryHtml:
Set one or more event flags.
Payload[0] low 16 bits = starting flag ID; bits [31:16] = bitmask value.
arg2 bits [3:0] = count−1 (how many consecutive flags to write).
Loops: for each flag, writes the lowest bit of the bitmask via SetConfigEventFlag, shifts mask right 1, increments flag ID.

name: SCENE_ENV
summaryHtml:
Push or pop scene-environment state.
arg2 bit 0: 0 = push (save), 1 = pop (restore).
Payload[0] bitmask selects which subsystems to save/restore:
  • bit 0 — RadiTimeEnable
  • bit 1 — MapAnimation + CameraHalt
  • bit 2 — Ambient
  • bit 3 — LightGF
  • bit 4 — CharacterHalt
  • bit 5 — CharacterDisp
  • bit 6 — MapDisp
  • bit 7 — CameraSystem
  • bit 8 — WindowStatus
Push: allocates CRadiSceneSaveEnv if absent, calls each Push* method. Pop: calls Pop* in reverse; frees object when stack empties.

name: CHAR_ANIM
summaryHtml:
Character animation control (schedule-based).
Dispatches on arg2 bits [1:0]:
  • 0 — Set animation parameters (bone masks: 5-bit fields for up to 4 channels, 0x3F = "all")
  • 1 — Attach SSF node / play animation (TraverseScheduleList)
  • 2 — Stop / reset animation (clears schedule + offset 0x70)
arg2 == 0x1FF triggers error ("r_script_run0.cpp" line 0x304).

name: TIME_ENABLE
summaryHtml:
Control the in-game time system.
arg2 bits [1:0]: 0 = read state from scene bit 29, else value−1 → enable/disable time.
arg2 bit 5: update scene time-enable flag (bit 29 of [scene_data+0]).
arg2 bits [7:6]: if non-zero, calls CRadiApp::SetRadiataTimeEnable(value−1).

name: CALC
summaryHtml:
General-purpose ALU / data calculator.
Reads two source operands (type field selects source):
  • 0 — Flags (multi-bit readback)
  • 1 — Event value (GetEventValueForScript)
  • 2 — Character stat (CCharacterManager via __ptmf_scall)
  • 3 — App state (CRadiApp via __ptmf_scall)
  • 4 — Item count (GetAbstractionItemNumber)
  • 5 — Stand-pos / float→int
  • 15 — Literal (direct from payload)
Applies operation (bits [2:0] of payload word): 0=set, 1=add, 2=sub, 3=mul, 4=div, 5=mod, 6=AND, 7=OR.
Writes result to destination (bits [7:4]): 0=flags, 1=event value, 2=char stat, 3=app state, 4=item, 5=float slot.

name: SET_DEFAULT
summaryHtml:
Set the default character and/or object name for this script slot.
arg2 bit 0: if set, reads a character ID from payload (bit 7 of arg2 = resolve via GetEventValueForScript) and calls SetDefaultCharacter.
arg2 bit 1: if set, reads an object-name pointer from payload and calls SetDefaultObjectName (NULL → clear).

name: SCENE_SETUP
summaryHtml:
Full scene initialization.
Resets the stand-pos table (25 entries), clears counts, zeroes camera/map/character flags.
Reads scene parameters from payload: map IDs (halfwords), option bitfield (controls actor-type / file slots), then facing/camera-link pair. Writes all results into dword_3B2500+0x304. Calls CCharaPutManager::GetLifeFlag for character status.

name: STAND_POS
summaryHtml:
Register a stand position.
Resolves a character ID via GetCharacterID. Reads a 0x14-byte record from payload (x/z coords as halfwords, facing byte, extra dword).
Searches the existing stand-pos table (up to 25 entries) for duplicates or a matching slot, then appends the entry at dword_3B2500+0x334. Error "r_script_run0.cpp" line 0x45E on table overflow.

name: PARTY
summaryHtml:
Party management.
Resolves character from payload. arg2 bits [1:0]:
  • 0 — Release from party (CRadiApp::ReleaseParty), force-flag from bit 7
  • 1 — Add to party (CRadiApp::AddParty), force-flag from bit 7
  • 2 — Set party leader (writes char ID to scene_data+0x830)
  • 3 — Set active member: scans 4 party slots at scene_data+0x834, sets bit 0 for match, clears for others

name: ITEM
summaryHtml:
Item manipulation.
Resolves character and item ID via GetAbstractionItemNumber. arg2 bits [2:1]:
  • 0 — Add item (SetPossessionItem +count; bit 1 of extra flags = "new" flag)
  • 1 — Remove item (negate count, then SetPossessionItem)
  • 2 — Query: get item at slot index, store item ID into event value
  • 3 — Clear all: loop DeletePossessionItem for every item
Supports event-value indirection for item ID and count. Result written to scene_data+0x454.

name: EQUIP
summaryHtml:
Equipment management.
Resolves character + item via abstraction. If arg2 bit 1 set and char ID < 0x131: checks party membership, searches item in personal data, calls SetEquipedItemByIndex then ReflectArmorModelingType.
arg2 bits [7:6] non-zero: dispatches to EquipAllType or DispEquipment.

name: WINDOW
summaryHtml:
Window-manager dispatcher (largest handler, ~0x900 bytes).
Payload[0] low 16 bits = window sub-type; bits [31:16] = message-type code.
Builds a typed parameter struct for the sub-type then calls CRadiWindowManager::SendMessage three times (create=1, params, show=0xB).
Sub-types include:
  • 5/6 — Dialog box (char ID, portrait, text ID, options)
  • 7 — Item-select menu
  • 9 — Textbox (position, size, colors, scroll)
  • 0xA — Item-get notification
  • 0xE — Character in/out window
  • 0x12 — Simple text overlay
  • 0x14 — Friend-get window
  • 0x17 — Stand-pos / char-select
  • 0x18 — Item-get (event)
  • 0x1B — Number input / value display

name: CAMERA
summaryHtml:
Scene camera control (initial params).
arg2 bitmask selects what to update:
  • bit 0 — Camera facing (low 10 bits from payload, OR'd into scene_data+0x84A)
  • bit 1 — Camera target stand-pos (top 6 bits combined with existing low 10 bits)
  • bit 2 — Camera position: 3 floats → scene_data+0x810
  • bit 3 — Camera look-at target: 3 floats → scene_data+0x820

name: FADE_SPEED
summaryHtml:
Set fade speed.
Reads a single float from payload[0] and writes it to dword_3B2500+0x16C. 6 instructions total (no branches).

name: FILE_MANAGE
summaryHtml:
File load / release.
arg2 bit 0:
  • 0 — Load: reads halfword file ID from payload[0], calls LoadPackingFile
  • 1 — Release: arg2 bits [7:4] = slot index (< 8), calls CFileObject::ReleaseFile at slot*0x20 + 0x1D8

name: PAUSE_SPEED
summaryHtml:
Set pause/resume speed.
Reads a single float from payload[0]. Calls WhetherCanPause; if return ≥ 0, writes float to dword_3B2500+0x178. Silently dropped if pause is not allowed.

name: CHAR_CREATE
summaryHtml:
Character creation & data loading (~700-line handler).
Two modes selected by s6:
  • 0 (Standard) — Gets empty slot → CreateCharacter → stores ID via SetEventValueForScript → loads modeling, action, then 8 animation data slots
  • 2 (DataCenter) — Uses CRadiDataCenter to load/release modeling, action, 8 animation slots, and algorithm data

name: CHAR_DELETE
summaryHtml:
Character delete or detach.
Bit 0 of parameter:
  • 0 — Full DeleteCharacter
  • 1 — DetachData_Main (detach data, keep character object)

name: CHAR_ATTACH
summaryHtml:
Attach character data, then optionally control rendering visibility.
Calls AttachData, then if mode flag set: sets no-render flag on the character and/or all its children (show/hide).

name: ANIM_PLAY
summaryHtml:
Complex animation play.
Three modes:
  • EzLasting — Blended / looping animation (SwitchMotionEzLasting)
  • Direct — Immediate hard-cut animation (SwitchMotionDirect)
  • Sub-animation — Secondary animation channel (SetSubAnimation)
Uses GetAbstractionAnimationNumber for animation ID resolution.

name: ANIM_SPEED
summaryHtml:
Animation playback speed and blend control.
Accesses character sub-manager 0x16 for motion switch configuration. Controls interpolation speed and blend weights.

name: ANIM_STOP
summaryHtml:
Stop a currently playing animation.
Parameter selects main animation channel (vtable+0x18 virtual call) or sub-animation channel (StopSubAnimation).

name: PARENT_ATTACH
summaryHtml:
Attach character to a parent object (another character or background element).
Searches for "Root" bone as the attachment point. Supports character-to-character and character-to-background parenting.

name: PARENT_DETACH
summaryHtml: Detach character from its parent object. Reverse of 0x26.

name: PATH_MOVE
summaryHtml:
Path/waypoint-based movement setup.
Allocates a movement buffer, reads waypoints in a loop using stand-position abstraction IDs. Character will follow the defined path.

name: MOVE_PAUSE
summaryHtml: Pause the character's current movement.

name: MOVE_ADV
summaryHtml:
Advanced character movement (9-case switch, ~1000 lines):
  • MoveStart — Begin movement to target position
  • VibrationPosition — Oscillate around a point
  • Rotation via atan2f angle math
  • Connect — Link to target movement
  • StraightMove — Direct linear movement
  • ThrowPosition — Ballistic / throw trajectory
  • FallControl — Gravity fall parameters
  • CatchCameraPosition — Move to camera target position

name: ANIM_PRECREATE
summaryHtml:
Pre-create animation controller for a character,
    preparing animation data for future playback without starting it.

name: CHAR_PERSIST
summaryHtml:
Control character data persistence across scene changes.
  • Mode 0 — Set persistence for all SSF handlers (SetPersistenceAll)
  • Mode 1 — Set persistence for character and all children

name: CHAR_ROTATE
summaryHtml:
Character rotation / orientation (16-case switch, ~1100 lines).
Sub-cases cover: target tracking, posture adjustment, rotation speed control, and various orientation modes via CCharacterRotate and CCharacterOption.

name: NOP
summaryHtml: No operation. Returns 0 immediately.

name: CHAR_ATTR
summaryHtml: Set character collision attribute and general character attribute flags.

name: CHAR_POS
summaryHtml:
Set or move character position.
Two modes: animated movement (MovePosition) or instant teleport (SetCharaPosition).

name: CHAR_RENDER
summaryHtml:
Character rendering and collision parameters.
Configures collision shape data, UV texture offsets, and bone-level parameters via CCharacterCollision::SetupCollisionData.

name: CHAR_AUTORATE
summaryHtml:
Auto-rate interpolation animation for visual properties, each with an optional WithChild variant:
  • Color (RGBA fade)
  • Transparency / alpha
  • Scale
  • Palette blend
  • Visibility toggle

name: EYE_CTRL
summaryHtml:
Eye movement control (6-case switch).
Cases: set eyeball texture number, set movement type (auto-track / fixed / etc.), and set manual eye direction for cutscene-specific eye poses.

name: FACE_EXPR
summaryHtml:
Facial expression control for dialogue and cutscenes.
Controls blink patterns (BlinkControll) and mouth movement (MouthControll) for lip-sync and emoting.

name: CHAR_LIFE
summaryHtml:
Character life/status flags management.
Operates through CSingleManager and character sub-manager index 1.

name: CHAR_QUERY
summaryHtml:
Query character state (15-case switch). Read-only. Stores result via SetEventValueForScript.
Queryable values include: position X/Y/Z, rotation, current animation name/frame/signal, and custom arithmetic operations on the queried value.

name: CHAR_VFX
summaryHtml:
Character visual effects (~1000 lines) via CChrEffectManager (sub-manager 6):
  • Motion trail / tail effects
  • Pixelation / mosaic filter
  • Visibility control

name: PARTICLE
summaryHtml: Search for and trigger particle effects attached to a character's model hierarchy.

name: EVENT_LEAVE
summaryHtml: Control character event enter/leave behavior for scene transition management. Operates through CCharaEventLeaveManager (sub-manager 0x13).

name: CHAR_CAPTURE
summaryHtml: Capture character state (position/rotation) and create fixed reference objects for cinematics. Characters are locked to specific transforms via CFixObject and CCharacterCapture.

name: MOTION_BLEND
summaryHtml:
Apply strong motion blending for physics/dynamics simulation on character models
    (cloth, hair, secondary motion).

name: BG_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load background/map data. Background ID read from event value.

name: MAP_INOUT_CHECK
summaryHtml: Trigger a check of all character persons for map in/out status via CCharacterPersonManager (sub-manager 0x11).

name: BG_SETTING_MAP
summaryHtml:
Configure / set up a map in the background system.
    Allocates a script execution slot for map logic.

name: BG_DELETE
summaryHtml: Unload / delete background data from memory.

name: MAP_CHANGE
summaryHtml:
Change the active map. After map change, revives/respawns characters
    through the put manager.

name: BG_ADV_DISP
summaryHtml:
Advanced background display control using character position,
    distance threshold, and viewing angle parameters.

name: BG_FUNC
summaryHtml: Generic background system function wrapper. Calls CBackGround::StopAnimation on the CBackGround object.

name: BG_DISP
summaryHtml:
Multi-purpose background rendering control:
    toggle background display, set visibility flags, enable/disable light shadows.

name: LANDSCAPE_VIS
summaryHtml: Set visibility of landscape / hierarchical scene objects.

name: LANDSCAPE_POS
summaryHtml:
Get landscape group header and set its world-space position.
    Used for moving landscape elements during cutscenes.

name: VIB_VECTOR
summaryHtml: Set vibration vector parameters for background object oscillation / environmental shake.

name: BG_SEARCH
summaryHtml: Search background data for specific named elements.

name: BG_DATA_SETUP
summaryHtml:
Set background data parameters: position offset, scale factor, global value.
    All written via inline setters.

name: BG_AUTORATE
summaryHtml: Auto-rate interpolation animation for background objects (mirrors character 0x32): color, alpha, scale, palette, visibility.

name: BG_QUERY
summaryHtml: Query background object state (15-case switch, mirrors character 0x36): position, rotation, animation frame. Result stored via SetEventValueForScript.

name: MAP_OBJ_DISP
summaryHtml:
Map object visibility control:
  • By character proximity
  • By camera position
  • Reset to default

name: CAM_SELECT
summaryHtml:
Select the active camera and set its target character.
    Controls character display instant-mode for camera cuts.

name: CAM_MODE
summaryHtml:
Configure camera system operating mode:
    set camera parameters from predefined setups, control rail-based camera movement.

name: CAM_ROTATE
summaryHtml:
Complex camera rotation and movement.
Captures character position for reference, calculates angles using atan2f / fmodf, applies acceleration and rotation. Used for dynamic camera orbiting around characters.

name: CAM_ANIM
summaryHtml: Play a predefined camera animation with parameters for speed, blend factor, and coefficient curves.

name: CAM_POS
summaryHtml:
Camera positioning (6-case switch).
Modes: at character location, at map/stand point, fixed world position, offset from target. Uses PS2 VU0 coprocessor (cop2) for matrix math transformations.

name: CAM_TARGET
summaryHtml:
Camera target tracking: creates a capture object that follows a character
    with position/posture tracking and configurable smooth coefficient.

name: CAM_MOVE
summaryHtml: General camera movement wrapper.

name: CAM_VIBRATE
summaryHtml:
Camera shake / vibration effect.
Allocates a PositionVib object (r_PositionVib.h), configures vibration vector parameters for shake intensity and frequency.

name: CAM_RESET
summaryHtml: Reset camera system: delete all camera elements and rebuild the pivot matrix from scratch.

name: CAM_MOVE_COLOR
summaryHtml:
Combined camera movement with environment color animation:
    moves camera while simultaneously playing fog color and ambient color animations
    for atmosphere transitions.

name: CAM_BG_FLAGS
summaryHtml: Direct byte writes to CBackGround+0x1514 rendering flag sub-structures. Pure inline memory manipulation; no function calls.

name: TEX_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load a texture file by ID into a specified texture slot.

name: PAF_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load a PAF (Primitive Animation File) from the data center into a slot.

name: SPRITE_SETUP
summaryHtml:
Comprehensive 2D sprite setup (large handler).
Creates a texture page, then configures: color, rotation, blend mode, dimensions, UV coordinates through a series of virtual method calls on the sprite object.
funcs: vtable: color / rotation / blend / size / UV

name: PAF_RESET
summaryHtml:
Reset PAF animation sequences: loop through active entries and destroy each one.
    Optionally calls a cleanup function.

name: PAF_PLAY
summaryHtml:
Play a PAF animation sequence.
Gets PAF data address, validates "PAF1" magic header, sets display offset, then starts playback.

name: PAF_STOP
summaryHtml: Stop a currently playing PAF animation sequence.

name: PRIM_PRIORITY
summaryHtml: Set the rendering priority / draw order for a primitive element.

name: FADE
summaryHtml:
Screen transitions / fades:
  • Color fade (RGBA)
  • Dissolve transition
  • Battle-entry fade

name: SCREEN_PARAM
summaryHtml:
Screen rendering parameters (post-processing / filter settings).
    Direct memory writes to the parameter structure; no function calls.

name: PRIM_CTRL
summaryHtml: Direct single-byte write to a primitive control structure.

name: PRIM_MOVE
summaryHtml: Primitive sprite animation movement (5-case switch).

name: BGM_SETUP
summaryHtml: Set up BGM with a full parameter structure: track ID, volume, fade-in/out times.

name: BGM_PLAY
summaryHtml: Start playing previously configured BGM.

name: BGM_STOP
summaryHtml: Stop or pause BGM. Bit 7 of parameter: 0 = stop, 1 = pause.

name: BGM_VOLUME
summaryHtml: Set BGM playback volume.

name: SND_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load SE (sound effect) files or battle voice files.

name: SE_PLAY
summaryHtml:
Sound effect playback with multiple 3D positioning modes:
    direct 3D position, character-attached (follows character), BG-attached.

name: SE_STOP
summaryHtml: Stop an individual SE, or fade out all SEs simultaneously.

name: SND_MODE
summaryHtml: Set sound system mode flag. Direct write to CRadiSound+0xE0.

name: SND_LISTENER
summaryHtml:
Set the 3D audio listener position. Multiple positioning modes:
    character-relative or world-absolute.

name: SE_PUSHPOP
summaryHtml: Push or pop all SE state for scene transitions (save/restore entire SE context).

name: MOVIE_PLAY
summaryHtml: Play an FMV (Full Motion Video) by ID with position parameters.

name: MOVIE_STOP
summaryHtml: Stop FMV playback.

name: VIB_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load vibration / rumble data by ID from the data center.

name: VIB_SEQ_PLAY
summaryHtml:
Play a vibration sequence. Four data source modes:
    action data, engine data, KODS address, or file object.

name: VIB_SEQ_STOP
summaryHtml: Stop a currently playing vibration sequence.

name: VIB_DIRECT
summaryHtml:
Play direct controller vibration with packed parameters:
bits [31:16] = duration, bits [15:8] = type, bits [7:0] = intensity.

name: TALK_LOAD
summaryHtml: Load talk / dialog script data by file ID.

name: TALK_START
summaryHtml:
Start a dialog / RMF sequence.
arg2 bit 0: if set, reads char ID + portrait byte from payload[0]; otherwise uses slot defaults.
Calls CRadiScript::AttachMessageData (mode from bits [2:1]).
On success, optionally calls CTalk::RmfExit to close a prior dialog, then CTalk::RmfStart with the text ID from payload, flags from bit 6 (voice) and bit 7 (auto-advance). Returns −1 on AttachMessageData failure.

name: WINDOW_MSG
summaryHtml: Window manager messaging: 5 sequential SendMessage calls (types: 5, 1, 0xB, 0xC, 0x3EC).

name: BUSTUP_DISP
summaryHtml:
Display character bust-up / portrait image during dialogue.
    Parameters: side (left/right), portrait ID, display mode.

name: TEXT_POS_COLOR
summaryHtml:
Set text display position (X/Y coordinates) and RGBA colors.
    Direct memory writes; no function calls.

name: TEXT_DISPLAY
summaryHtml:
Text message display (3-case switch):
  • 0 — Display direct SJIS text string
  • 1 — Convert number to wide text and display
  • 7 — Clear text by ID / clear text cache

name: BTL_CHAR_CTRL
summaryHtml:
Master battle character controller (14-case switch, 7376-byte stack frame).
Cases include: fall start, battle action (flag 0xDC), disable collision, fall section, float flag bit-toggling, complex battle interaction (damage calculation, collision detection), and plugin vtable dispatch (vtable+0x50 / 0xA8 / 0xAC / 0x58 / 0x104).

name: NOP
summaryHtml: No operation. Returns 0 immediately.

name: SCHEDULE_LIST
summaryHtml: Set NPC schedule list number. Also modifies person flag bit 6.

name: CHAR_RELOCATE
summaryHtml:
Relocate character to a different map: load new map, perform map change,
    then check character in/out for the new map.

name: NOP
summaryHtml: No operation. Returns 0 immediately.

name: PERSON_ALLOW
summaryHtml: Set NPC allow attribute with direction parameters.

name: PERSON_PARAM
summaryHtml:
Set NPC person data fields (offsets 0x34A–0x34E, 0x83, flag bits).
    Fields are only written if the value ≠ 0xFFFF.

name: TIME_SCHEDULE
summaryHtml:
Control in-game time: set hours (÷24) and minutes (÷60),
    write time-of-day mode. Also handles schedule system allocation.

name: PERSON_LINK
summaryHtml:
Link two NPCs together: validates both characters,
    writes linked ID to person offset 0x348.
    Bit 2 of flags = clear the link instead.

name: PERSON_INCLUDE
summaryHtml: Set the "include character" on an NPC with slot index, character ID, and type.

name: BTL_CREATE
summaryHtml:
Battle character creation / setup (~900-line handler).
Gets battle sub-manager 0x12, resolves characters, creates battle entry, sets action ID, assigns up to 6 plugin messages, initializes plugin group. Optional: link setup (type 0x402), group assignments.

name: BTL_AUTOSCALE
summaryHtml: Battle auto-scale adjustment. Searches target for "AutoScaleAdjust" bone to derive scale factor. Fallback: collision radius ÷ 30.0. Applies result via vtable+0x44.

name: BTL_QUERY
summaryHtml:
Battle query system (6-case switch, 2880-byte stack frame).
Cases: battle entity search (types 1–5), param holder read, stand position search with VU0 distance sort, get children.
All results stored via SetEventValueForScript.

name: BTL_COPY_CHAR
summaryHtml:
Copy a character for battle use.
Gets character class, calls CopyCharacter, stores the resulting new character ID via SetEventValueForScript.

name: BTL_DISTANCE
summaryHtml:
Battle distance / interaction calculation between two characters.
Uses ProcessTaskReady(4) readiness check, calls dword_405E30 with float parameter. Stores result as a position vector (4 floats at slot offsets 0x60–0x6C).

name: BTL_SPECIAL_FX
summaryHtml:
Execute or abort special effects for battle.
Two modes (bit 7 of parameter):
  • 0 — Execute: sets default memory manager context, calls ExecuteSpecialEffect_Main
  • 1 — Abort: calls AbortSpecialEffect with character and effect IDs

name: BTL_PLUGIN_MSG
summaryHtml:
Send a plugin message to a battle character.
Gets battle sub-manager 0x12, resolves char → battle entry.
  • type = 4: allocates CBtlChrPluginMsgParamOrderTactics (16 bytes) with 3 char IDs
  • otherwise: allocates CBtlChrPluginMsgParamBit32 (8 bytes)
Dispatches via loc_3BFCD0.

name: PUT_LIFE_FLAG
summaryHtml:
Attach a life flag to a character via the put manager (sub-manager 2).
    Resolves character, reads event value for flag data.

name: PUT_QUERY
summaryHtml:
Query event/put data (3-case switch):
  • 0 — Get group total flag number
  • 1 — CCharaPutManager::GetGroupLiveFlagNumber
  • 2 — CCharaPutManager::GetGroupDefaultLiveFlagNumber
Result stored via SetEventValueForScript.

name: PUT_EVENT_VALUE
summaryHtml: Set an event value on the put sub-manager 2. Reads event value for script, then calls CCharaPutManager::SetGroupLiveFlagNumber with it.

name: SCHEDULE_CTRL
summaryHtml:
Schedule / slot flag control (3-case on bits [30:28] of parameter):
  • 2 — Set schedule percent for NPC character person (SetSchedulePercent)
  • 7 — Set bit 5 of slot byte 0 (internal slot flag toggle)

name: NOP
summaryHtml: Handler returns 0 immediately (jr $ra; move $v0, $zero).
